name: Cluster
summary: Children in a row that wraps onto more lines when it runs out of room (or keeps to one line), with one gap from a space role: the layout owns the space, so a view never needs a styled wrapper or a margin. Not for children in a column (use Stack) or for a row of actions on something (use the component that owns them).
a11y: A plain `div` with no role: it arranges, it doesn't group for assistive technology. Reading order is the source order, whatever the wrapping.

props.name: gap
props.description: The space between children in the row, by how strongly they belong together: `pair` (an icon and its number) up to `group`; `none` for compact icon buttons that touch, their own hover fill showing each one's bounds (a design tool's alignment row). Wrapped lines keep a pair's space between them.

props.name: justify
props.description: How the row's free room is shared: `start` (default) keeps children together at the start; `end` keeps them together at the end (a row of actions closing a form); `between` spreads them across the row, the first and last at its edges (a design tool's alignment row filling its panel).

props.name: align
props.description: How children line up across the row: centred (marks beside text), on the first line of text, at the top (items of different heights, such as fields), at the bottom (`end`: a button level with an unhinted field beside it, under that field's label), or `control`: a form row, every child that isn't a field level with the fields' controls (under their labels, above their hints) and keeping its own width while the fields share the room, the row no wider than one field (size.measure).

props.name: shares
props.description: With lign="control", each child's share of the row's room by order (1-3, default all 1): [1, 2] gives the second field twice the first's width (LR81). Children that aren't fields keep their own width whatever their share.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap onto more lines when the row runs out of room (default), or keep one line and let text inside shrink and wrap instead.
